title: ValidationRule
description: One named check. Tagged union on `check`. See 01-data-management.md §4.3 and §4.5. Reconciled against `model_schema.ValidationRule` on 2026-08-23 (W32-2, FR-68), when the shape first gained a generated counterpart under `generated/` and FR-451's drift guard. This file was the wrong side on three counts and the code the right one: `severity` listed `info`, which `Severity` has never had and which §4.4's 2026-08-15 amendment ruled out (a rule carries one severity); `check` enumerated a vocabulary that never matched `pricing_core.data.validate.CHECKS` — `set_membership` and `uniqueness` are not registered and most of the registry was absent — while §4.5 says the vocabulary is enforced when the rule *runs*, not when it is authored; and `owner` and `dry_run_result_id` are carried by no field of the model and emitted by no projection (`app.platform.validation_rules.to_schema`). The dry-run obligation FR-50 states is real and lives on the row (`validation_rules.dry_run_report_id`, note the name) and in `approved_rule_dry_run_and_separate_approver`; it was never part of this wire shape.

check.description: A name registered in `pricing_core.data.validate.CHECKS`. Not enumerated here: §4.5 enforces the vocabulary when the rule runs — an unknown check produces an `error` outcome that FR-48 refuses to count as a pass — and an enum copied into this file is a second register that drifts, which is what it did.

catalogue_id.description: The 01 §4.4 catalogue entry this rule was seeded from, or null for a workspace's own rule (FR-68).

then.description: A single read-only SELECT, executed in a sandboxed DuckDB connection (NFR-473).
